overview: Interactive UFW firewall setup for Himosoft Server A. Opens HTTP/HTTPS to the world, restricts SSH and K3s API (6443) to your admin IP, and optionally allows database ports from a replica/monitoring server.

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-firewall

steps.title: Configure firewall
steps.body: Prompts for admin IP and optional replica IP. Shows proposed rules before applying.

notes: Default rules: allow 80/tcp, 443/tcp; allow 22 and 6443 from admin IP only
Optional replica IP opens 3306, 5432, 27017, 6379 from that source
Run before or after K3s install — recommended before exposing the server
